groups.canonical_name: New vehicle program launch execution failure
groups.definition: Risk that new automotive programs or products are launched late, over budget or unsuccessfully, causing added costs, customer penalties, lost business and reputational harm.
Risk that newly introduced products fail to achieve market acceptance or are not developed and launched successfully, harming revenue and returns on development investment.
Risk that new technologies such as electrified vehicles and autonomous driving systems perform poorly or defectively, leading to customer claims, government investigations and recalls.
